item.subject: science
item.stem:
Rohan pushes his steel tiffin box across two different table surfaces at home.
On the smooth glass dining table the box slides a long way before stopping. On the rough wooden study table it stops much sooner.
Which statement correctly explains why the box stops sooner on the wooden table?

options.A: Friction acts only after the box has stopped, so it pulls the box backwards on the wooden table.
options.B: The rough wooden surface has more irregularities, so it produces greater friction that opposes the motion and slows the box faster.
options.C: Friction is the same on both surfaces, but the box is heavier on the wooden table so it stops sooner.
options.D: The smooth glass surface produces more friction because the box moves faster on it.
